description: Brainstorm dishes for a vague idea (cuisine, theme, occasion, flavor). Read-only; saves nothing. Returns {step: choose_style|choose_dish, style_options or options:[{name, description, time, difficulty, saved, id}]}; show them as a short numbered list. After the user picks: start_recipe_draft for a new dish, or get_recipe if saved is true.

category.description: The user's idea in their words, e.g. "Chinese", "cozy fall dinner", "something with lemon"

name: suggest_dishes
title: Suggest dishes
